== Set 1 edition names ==
Bill approved consistent Luke/Vader Set 1 names: Original (unnumbered), Numbered (black-on-white) / Numbered (white-on-black) for the distinct Dark Side options, one Numbered entry for Luke’s identical Light Side panels, Premium, and Remastered (2006). Article moves retain redirects; the shared navigators and direct links use the descriptive edition names. Publication history replaces the generic Errata heading on these Set 1 articles; historical catalog codes are retained in source. Card identities, printed text, statistics, images and source attribution are unchanged. Legacy Block classifications are outside this batch. Story 384 ~~~~
